title: Drivers professionalism and audience engagement.
text: I brought a 20 Minute Lamborghini ride for my Son with an English speaking driver, to see his excitement when he returned was epic. An absolute credit to the driver for his engagement with my Son. I could not be more appreciative that he tailored the experience for my 11 yr old and it has provided us both memorable experiences. Thank you very much.

title: Unique experience!
text: I was in a porsche plate 2024 over 400cv twinturbo, Ana and Arnau (driver) were very friendly and nice as well as very professional, also being my birthday they gave me the video filmed with a gopro totally free, I will always remember this experience being part of my trip to Barcelona
author: danielvV5918YG

title: Fun super car drive
text: I had pre booked a 911 GT3 for 20 mins drive with instructor, the car arrived right on time and the car was in excellent condition and (adri) my instructor was super friendly and allowed me to push the car whenever possible. It was one hell of an experience. They have a great fleet of cars. They also have options where you can sit in the car and click pictures, turn on engines and rev the cars. If you love supercars and want to experience them, then it's a must try. Just a small suggestion to drive me to Barcelona, please try and add some more roads where we can push the car to its real limits
author: tagme123

title: Top
text:
Don’t miss this experience... my children were amazed and my husband delighted to be able to be the driver of a Ferrari even if for only 20 minutes. Money well spent! Unique emotions! Very friendly staff!
Stra recommended!
author: Milannelcuore

title: Awesome Driving Experiences
text:
To The Team @ Drive Me Barcelona, thank you for your effects for making my driving experiences unforgettable and amazing. 

I thoroughly enjoyed driving the two Lamborghini’s (Huracan EVO Spyder & Tecnica) and Porsche GT3. 

It was a dream to drive a supercar and you’ve made it come true!

Many thanks to your instructors Roger and Adri. They are excellent instructors. 

Highly recommend Drive Me Barcelona to everyone who wishes to experience driving a supercar. 

Best regards 

Mizan

title: Amazing experience, incredible cars, great staff!
text: It was an incredible experience, straight out of GTA. The staff was amazing, the Ferrari was amazing. Szymon is such a great guy, very patient with our group, gave us some great deals, and very helpful. Definitely would recommend!
